actions.operation: [OP:FINITE_CASE_ENUMERATION] Represent a placement by an unordered pair of nonnegative box occupancies summing to the given ball count and enumerate the smaller occupancy through half that total.
[OP:GEOMETRIC_SERIES_DIFFERENTIATION] Form the ordinary generating function for partitions into at most two parts and extract the coefficient at the requested ball count.

strategies.plan: [KERNEL:unordered_occupancy_scan] List every canonical occupancy pair directly.
[KERNEL:partition_generating_function] Extract the required coefficient from the finite-part partition series.

actions.operation: [OP:EUCLIDEAN_ALGORITHM] Take an integer linear combination of n+7 and 2n+1 to obtain a constant divisible by every possible gcd, then exhibit an n attaining that bound.
[OP:FINITE_CASE_ENUMERATION] Enumerate n by residue class modulo the constant produced by the Euclidean combination, evaluate both expressions in each class, and select the largest attainable gcd.

strategies.plan: [KERNEL:symbolic_euclidean_bound] Prove a universal gcd bound by a linear combination and construct equality.
[KERNEL:residue_class_gcd_scan] Exhaust the finite residue classes and compare their attainable gcd values.

actions.operation: [OP:ARITHMETIC_MEAN] Use symmetry of the odd-length consecutive list to equate median and mean, then divide the given total by the term count and return that numeric quotient.
[OP:ARITHMETIC_SEQUENCE_SUM] Write the endpoint sum formula, solve for the first term, advance to the unique central term, and return its numeric value.

strategies.plan: [KERNEL:median_equals_mean_numeric] Compute the median directly as the list mean.
[KERNEL:sequence_endpoint_numeric] Solve the arithmetic-series endpoint equation and index its center.

actions.operation: [OP:PRIME_FACTORIZE] Factor the fixed final term into prime powers.
[OP:PRIME_EXPONENT_ACCUMULATION] Require the integer common ratio squared to divide the final term and determine the largest ratio compatible with strict increase.
[OP:ARITHMETIC] Divide the final term by that ratio squared and return the resulting first term.
[OP:FINITE_CASE_ENUMERATION] Enumerate every integer ratio in its finite square-root bound, test integrality and strict increase, and return the first term from the unique passing ratio.

strategies.plan: [KERNEL:factor_exponent_complete] Use prime exponents to constrain the ratio and explicitly compute the first term.
[KERNEL:complete_integer_ratio_scan] Exhaust ratios and explicitly return the first term from the passing case.

actions.operation: [OP:CONSTRUCT_OBJECT] Contract the three named people into a super-person while preserving every internal order.
[OP:COMBINATION_PRODUCT] Count circular permutations of the contracted objects and multiply by the block's internal permutations.

[OP:FINITE_CASE_ENUMERATION] Fix a labeled person at a reference seat, enumerate every permutation of all remaining people, directly test whether the named people occupy a consecutive cyclic run, and return the passing count.

strategies.plan: [KERNEL:circular_block_contraction] Count with a contracted consecutive block.
[KERNEL:literal_anchored_seating_scan] Exhaust anchored circular seatings and test cyclic adjacency directly.

actions.operation: [OP:PLANE_CROSS_PRODUCT] Form two displacement vectors from the given points, take their cross product, normalize its integer components, and determine the constant by substitution.
[OP:AFFINE_COORDINATE_AREA] Set the affine four-column determinant containing a variable point and all listed points to zero, expand its cofactors, and normalize the resulting integer equation.

strategies.plan: [KERNEL:normal_vector_cross_product] Obtain the plane normal from a vector cross product.
[KERNEL:affine_coplanarity_determinant] Expand a coplanarity determinant without constructing a cross product.
